title: Admin enters a tournament score
description: Open the seeded active Round Robin, click an empty match cell, enter the set scores, and save the result.

steps.title: Admin on Players
steps.body: Club admins who also organize can open active tournaments and enter match scores from the event page.

steps.title: Open Tournaments
steps.body: Go to the tournaments list to find the active Round Robin seeded for tutorials.

steps.title: Active tournaments
steps.body: Tutorial Active Round Robin is already running with a full matrix of empty match cells.
steps.resultNote: Tournaments list shows the Active stage.

steps.title: Open the active event
steps.body: Open Tutorial Active Round Robin to reach the scoring grid.

steps.title: Round Robin score grid
steps.body: Each empty cell is a match yet to be played. Click a cell to open the score entry dialog.
steps.resultNote: Active Round Robin matrix is visible with Enter score controls.

steps.title: Open a match cell
steps.body: Choose any empty match. The Match Entry dialog opens for the two participants.

steps.title: Match Entry dialog
steps.body: Enter each player’s sets won. Organizers can also mark a forfeit when needed.
steps.resultNote: Match Entry popup is open with both score fields.

steps.title: Enter the score
steps.body: Type the set counts (here 3–1), then confirm with the green checkmark to record the match.
steps.actionHint: Click the green checkmark to save

steps.title: Score recorded
steps.body: The grid updates with the result (green for the row winner, red for the loser). Progress advances toward completing the Round Robin.
steps.resultNote: Match saved; at least one cell now shows a recorded score.
